Replaice solutions

Resolve routine requests. Give people the context for the hard ones.

Replaice Desk handles customer service and IT support requests across voice, email, messaging and web. It supports autonomous Level 1 resolution and escalation to Level 2 teams.

What you can do

  • Capture incoming requests and classify support tickets.
  • Retrieve approved knowledge and execute authorized resolution workflows.
  • Hand off exceptions to a human agent with the relevant ticket context.

Where Replaice adds value

Unify customer and IT requests

Use Replaice Desk to capture requests from voice, email, messaging and web and create a ticket with the relevant context.

Resolve repeatable Level 1 work

Retrieve approved knowledge and run authorised resolution steps for routine requests. Track resolution time and repeat contacts.

Give Level 2 teams a better handoff

Escalate exceptions with the issue summary, conversation history and steps already attempted, so the next person can pick up the ticket without restarting it.
